updater_competence.reason: Prompt-patch updater action space is degenerate; downstream admission learning is blocked. This does not reject Persistent Update Governance.
updater_competence.scientific_role: hard prerequisite before Gate 1; failure stops this updater/action surface, not the research problem

entries.basis: Keep the benchmark interaction horizon aligned with the competent ALFWorld agent setting rather than shortening it for cost.
Thirty-two candidates yield sixteen accepted updates and about eight harmful candidates at 25% planning prevalence, above the six-candidate identifiability minimum.
Twelve hidden tasks reduce per-candidate binary hidden-delta resolution to 8.33 percentage points for confirmatory evaluation.
Formal harmful-admission comparison is forbidden with fewer than six observed harmful candidates.
A 25% relative harmful-commit reduction is the preregistered minimum effect worth a confirmatory P0 claim.
Sixteen accepted candidates imply a 1/16 = 6.25 percentage-point observable resolution, so a 2pp tolerance would be unresolvable.
Qualified Qwen react-family throughput predicts about 10.59 worst-case GPU-hours; 12 GPUh preserves a safety margin.

identifiability.true_false_question: Would harmful-update admission differ between a drift-informed gate and matched acceptance simplifications?

throughput.reference: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct react-family on server 60 RTX3090, 24 ID environments, 50-step cap

recovery.restart_policy: Preserve completed atomic artifacts; diagnose the stop and restart a fresh confirmatory run from the same frozen config. Do not merge partial outcomes across runtimes.
recovery.partial_artifact_policy: Partial traces are diagnostic only and cannot enter the Pilot Registry.

scope_conditions: hidden truth is independent of update construction

assumptions.statement: The updater produces enough effect variation for admission to matter.
assumptions.observable_check: updater competence plus beneficial/neutral/harmful effect distribution

assumptions.statement: Pre-commit behavioral drift can contain incremental information about later harm.
assumptions.observable_check: same-information disagreement and hidden harm ranking versus the strongest simplification

principle_certificate.mechanism: Harmful persistent updates should induce measurable pre-commit behavioral divergence; a gate can use this signal to avoid harmful commits while retaining useful updates.

predictions.statement: A qualified updater produces nonzero and sign-varying downstream effects.
With a qualified updater, drift-informed admission separates harmful updates from matched simplifications.
predictions.observable: held-out harmful-commit reduction at bounded utility loss plus decision disagreement

operationalization.validity_check: synthetic realizability plus tiny-real-set fit and baseline disagreement

operationalization.measure: paired hidden-task utility delta after commit
operationalization.validity_check: independent hidden truth under matched update budget

falsification.contradiction_rule: Reject only the incremental drift-information sub-principle after a competent updater and valid measurement repeatedly fail the preregistered matched hidden test.

failure_update_rules.design-nonidentifiable: repair experiment design; no principle negative
failure_update_rules.assumption-violation: revise scope/assumption and derive a new prediction
failure_update_rules.matched-simplification: weaken/merge the current method realization, not the broader principle

hidden_evaluation_sealed.evidence: Hidden ALFWorld confirmatory tasks are outside update construction, model fitting, and threshold selection.

evaluation_artifacts_inaccessible.evidence: Hidden labels, scorer internals, and confirmatory outputs are not exposed to the updater or admission policy.

independent_truth_source.evidence: Task success and cross-task harm come from ALFWorld environment execution rather than self-judgment.

same_information_baselines.evidence: Matched baselines receive the same candidate updates, observable inputs, hidden-task budget, and acceptance count.

claim_metric_alignment.evidence: Confirmatory metrics directly test harmful-commit reduction at bounded target-gain loss.

versioned_evaluator.evidence: Config hash, source hash, parser, environment policy, and evaluation artifacts are versioned before execution.

shortcut_audit.evidence: Protocol forbids hidden-result cache reuse, public-solution lookup, evaluator introspection, and post-hoc split changes.
